    assert "mango" not in c.items()


def test_remove_item_zero_or_less_removes():

@ pytest.mark.parametrize("missing",["orange","banana"])
def test_remove_nonexistent_key(missing):

# --- subtotal ---------------------------------------------------------

def test_subtotal_calculation():
    c = Cart()
    # 3 apples @1.0 -> qty=3 => 5% discount
    c.add_item("apple", 1.0, quantity=3)
    assert c.subtotal() == round(1.0*3*(1-0.05),2)  # 2.85
    # 10 bananas @0.5 -> qty=10 => 5% discount
    c.add_item("banana", 0.5, quantity=10)
    expected = round((1.0*3*(1-0.05)) + (0.5*10*(1-0.05)),2)
    assert c.subtotal() == expected

def test_total_with_coupon_and_shipping():

    # 5 oranges @20 -> qty=5 => no bulk discount

    assert c.subtotal() == subtotal
    # apply coupon SAVE10 => 10% off
    total_after_coupon = subtotal * (1-0.10)  # 90

def test_total_invalid_coupon_raises():
    c = Cart()
    c.add_item("item",1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        c.total(coupon="invalid")
